name: Jared Stomber
bio:
Jared Stomber is a highly skilled tattoo artist renowned for his mastery in newschool and black & gray styles. His impeccable work is complemented by an unwavering commitment to maintain a pristine and hygienic workspace, ensuring each client's experience is not only visually stunning but also executed with the highest standards of cleanliness. Jared's portfolio and active involvement with professional teams such as @Goliathneedles and @NumbedRx speak volumes about his dedication to the art and industry of tattooing.
